State scenario passes with and without capture, time/account scenario passes without capture; page errors empty. Existing dashboard, extra-reminder, modern-draft and field-browser regressions pass.

An empty technician name also clears the active display context through the existing route loader, so the expected result is the translated missing-name label, not the former account name. Corrected the fixture expectation without changing product behavior.
